messages:
anya: Heads-up — I'm going to land a tiny config-editor change that adds a `staged_safety_probe` field for route configs. It lets ops run quota-routing changes in shadow/dry-run mode and surface a pass/fail telemetry gate. Posting snippet + plan now.

anya: ```yaml
route:
  id: "priority-route"
  staged_safety_probe:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.02
    telemetry_gate: "route.quota_safety_v1"
```

brian: Nice. Two asks: (1) telemetry_gate should emit both a counter and a rolling success gauge, (2) need a dashboard tile (heatmap/sparkline) for quick ops checks. @devex can you own the dashboard card? :eyes:

devex: Yep, I can do a compact card. UX note: show `probe status`, `sample_rate`, and `last_sample_time` + link to traces. Keep it one-click to open traces.

carol: Rollout plan? canary percentages and abort criteria?

anya: Plan draft: dry-run (shadow) for 2h at 2% sample_rate, then canary 5% for 30m, ramp to 25% if metrics look good, then 100%. Abort conditions: error-rate delta > 0.5% OR latency P99 increase > 50ms. Telemetry gate flips to "pass" only when sample success rate >= 99.8% for 1h.

brian: Add a replay trace id to each sampled request so we can correlate failures quickly. Header: `X-Config-Probe-ID` or similar.

anya: Good call — I'll add header. Also will emit metrics: `route.probe.sampled_count`, `route.probe.failures`, `route.probe.p99_delta_ms`.

ops-bot: ci:dry-run job submitted by anya — job id `dryrun-1758885678`

anya: Command I'm running locally for the smoke: `./cli config apply --route priority-route --dry-run --probe`

ops-bot: DRY-RUN OUTPUT:
```
DRY-RUN: sampled 120 requests in last 10m, failures 0 (0.0%), p99 +12ms
Telemetry gate: route.quota_safety_v1: not-yet-passed (0.0 -> needs >=99.8%)
```

brian: Can the probe emit a small sample payload to S3 for one-click replay? would help with root cause.

devex: I can wire the console card to show a "download samples" button that points at the snapshot bucket with pre-signed URLs. Also will add a "replay in traces" button that pre-fills the trace query using `X-Config-Probe-ID`.

carol: Ops will monitor the dry-run and the canary. @anya ping when PR is up and ready for review.

anya: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4812 — includes schema, validation, and the X-Config-Probe-ID header. Landing in ~30m unless objections.

brian: :thumbsup: lgtm, please add the metric docs.

ops-bot: dryrun-1758885678 finished — summary (2h): sampled 4600 requests, failures 3 (0.065%), avg p99 delta +8ms. No abort triggers. Telemetry gate still not passed (needs sustained 99.8%).

anya: Thanks — I'll watch the dashboard and start the canary once we get a quiet hour.

devex: I'll mock the card in staging and drop a link in #eng-platform when ready.

carol: Thanks all. Short and pragmatic — exactly what we wanted. :rocket:
